svg.text: Entry Foyer (Mudroom) with Bath · v4 Dual-Mode with Bed Locker

g.text: GUEST MODE: queen 60"x80" on folding frame
(drawn at 1" = 2 units; replaces the Murphy bed)
· back 7" slot: folding metal frame on edge
· front 18": tri-fold queen mattress on end
(fits up to 27" × 60" × 18"), in a zip bag
· strap keeps the frame from tipping out
Upper bay ~17": sheets, pillows, guest towels
Vent slots top + bottom of doors (foam needs air)
Lockable lower doors: in guest mode the empty
bay becomes your owner lock-off storage
UHMW / felt glide strips on the bay floor
3/4" plywood, sage paint, Shaker doors, black pulls
Anchor to wall studs (tall cabinet, tip-over risk)
Check your folded frame + mattress sizes before
building; adjust width/depth to fit with 1-2" spare.
